strict_host_key_checking.description: Whether to ask before adding a new host key (ask), reject unknown hosts (no), or auto-add (yes). 'ask' is recommended for security.

user_known_hosts_file.description: Path to the file storing known host public keys. Use per-user or global (e.g., '/etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts').

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Use DEBUG for troubleshooting; INFO for production.

default_port.description: Default port for SSH connections when not specified.

connect_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for connection establishment.

password_authentication.description: Whether to allow password authentication. Can be overridden per-host. Use 'no' for key-only auth.

forward_agent.description: Whether to forward your SSH agent to remote hosts. Enable only for trusted targets.

forward_x11.description: Whether to enable X11 forwarding. Required for GUI apps over SSH.

tcp_keep_alive.description: Send TCP keepalive packets to detect dead connections.

identity_files.description: List of private key files to try for public key authentication, in order of preference.

preferred_authentications.description: Comma-separated list of authentication methods in order of preference. Common: 'publickey,password'.

gssapi_authentication.description: Enable GSSAPI authentication (e.g., Kerberos). Only needed in enterprise environments.

compression.description: Enable compression for slow connections. Usually safe to leave enabled.

control_master.description: Enable SSH connection sharing (multiplexing) to reuse connections.

control_path.description: Path template for control sockets (used with ControlMaster). %r=%user, %h=%host, %p=%port.

control_persist.description: Time (seconds) to keep master connection alive after last session ends. 0 disables persistence.

proxy_command.description: Shell command to establish connection via proxy (e.g., 'nc -X 5 -x proxy.example.com %h %p'). Leave empty to disable.

exit_on_forward_failure.description: Whether to exit with error if port forwarding fails during connection setup.

quiet_mode.description: Suppress informational messages. Useful for scripts.

address_family.description: IP address family to use. 'any' = dual-stack; 'inet' = IPv4 only; 'inet6' = IPv6 only.

stream_local_bind_unlink.description: Unlink existing Unix socket before binding (for StreamLocalBindPath). Needed if socket left by stale process.

ciphers.description: List of allowed ciphers (comma-separated in config). Only set if strict cipher policies required.

macs.description: List of allowed MACs (comma-separated in config). Only set if strict MAC policies required.

add_keys_to_agent.description: Whether to add identity files to ssh-agent on connection (e.g., 'yes', 'confirm', 'ask').

identity_only.description: Only use identity files explicitly listed in IdentityFile/ssh-add (ignore other keys in agent).

server_alive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive messages to server. Non-zero helps prevent timeout on idle connections.

server_alive_count_max.description: Maximum keepalive messages without response before disconnecting.

request_tty.description: Request a TTY for remote commands (e.g., for sudo). 'force' always allocates TTY.

pubkey_authentication.description: Enable public key authentication globally (overrides per-host settings).

extra_hosts.description: List of predefined host blocks with custom settings (e.g., jump hosts, dev servers). Each object defines a Host block.

forward_agent.description: Enable agent forwarding for this host

forward_x11.description: Enable X11 forwarding for this host

identity_file.description: Specific identity file for this host
